005950e98e27.name: Formidable Resolve
005950e98e27.plain: This WARLORD adds 1 to its Leadership characteristic, and its Unquestionable Wisdom ability has 6" more range.

027f91138655.name: Universal Anathema
027f91138655.plain: Melee attacks by a model with this Relic always wound on a 2+, unless the target is a VEHICLE or TITANIC unit.

1501b2e8b901.name: Hector Rex
1501b2e8b901.plain: Psychic powers: Smite, plus 2 from the Telethesia discipline.

2c933d44e441.name: Tainted Blade
2c933d44e441.plain: Each failed saving throw against this weapon's attacks lets the bearer make 1 additional attack with it against the same unit. Those additional attacks can't create any more attacks. The first time the bearer is picked to fight in each Fight phase, roll one D6. If you roll a 1, the bearer takes 1 mortal wound and this weapon can't be used that phase.

452c7af9e61b.name: Esoteric Lore
452c7af9e61b.plain: While this WARLORD is on the battlefield, you gain 1 Command Point on a D6 roll of 5+ each time your opponent uses a Stratagem.

47b4910ae1ee.name: Ignis Judicium
47b4910ae1ee.plain: Attacks with this weapon have a Damage characteristic of D6+2 against a target within half range or with the CHAOS or PSYKER keyword.

62a57a1a9815.name: Radical
62a57a1a9815.plain: Once per battle round, you can re-roll one of this WARLORD's hit, wound or damage rolls, saving throws, Psychic tests or Deny the Witch tests.

6ca704fa07c7.name: The Sanctic Shield
6ca704fa07c7.plain: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save, adds 1 to its armour saving throws, and can avoid losing wounds to mortal wounds on a 5+. Each time a mortal wound would make this model lose a wound, roll one D6; on a 5+ it keeps that wound.

6d98172a6dff.name: Psychic Mastery
6d98172a6dff.plain: This WARLORD knows one more Telethesia psychic power, and can attempt to manifest one more power in your Psychic phase and deny one more in your opponent's.

78f2f7f43045.name: Digital Weapons
78f2f7f43045.plain: A model with this Relic can make 1 extra attack each time it fights, using the close combat weapon profile. If that attack hits, the target suffers 1 mortal wound and the attack sequence ends.

7fd4e90d22ae.name: Stratagem: Arbiter of the Emperor's Will
7fd4e90d22ae.plain: Before the battle, give a Warlord Trait to one INQUISITOR model in your army that isn't your Warlord, and possibly a Relic of the Inquisition as well. Determine one Warlord Trait for that model; it counts as your Warlord for the purposes of that trait. Then, if it isn't a named character or a VEHICLE, you can also give it one Relic of the Inquisition. Every Relic in your army must be different, and each must go to a different model. You can use this Stratagem only once per battle.

824ada22b10f.name: Blade of the Ordo
824ada22b10f.plain: Attacks made with this weapon against a unit named by the bearer's Quarry ability have a Damage characteristic of 3.

930b66e7d303.name: Puritan
930b66e7d303.plain: This WARLORD's invulnerable save improves by 1, but it can't get better than 3+.

b059b42b6865.name: No Escape
b059b42b6865.plain: This WARLORD can Heroically Intervene against enemies within 6" instead of 3", and can stop enemy units within 1" of it from Falling Back on a 4+. It can make a Heroic Intervention if any enemy units are within 6" of it rather than 3", and when it does, it can move up to 6" rather than 3". When an enemy unit within 1" of this WARLORD is picked to Fall Back, you can roll one D6: on a 4+ that unit can't Fall Back this turn, unless any of its models have a minimum Move characteristic.

c86cc2f72399.name: Arias
c86cc2f72399.plain: When an attack with this weapon wounds a DAEMON unit, that unit also suffers 1 mortal wound on top of the normal damage.
